sections.brief: Israel's stated aims (the Begin doctrine from Osirak 1981 and Syria 2007 to Iran; no Iranian bomb; ending Iran's network; regime-change statements of June 2025 and 28 Feb 2026) set beside IAEA/US findings and Iran's position; then five labelled arguments with the case against each: military supremacy and QME, ideology (Sadjadpour vs Parsi), the periphery reversed, domestic politics (Diskin, Yadlin vs Lapid/Bennett), alignment with US strategy. Figure: compare

What 'A Clean Break' (1996) and the Yinon essay (1982) actually say, their Iran mentions quoted exactly, authorship and Feith's denial, contested readings and misuse; oil and Hormuz as stakes (EIA), status as of October 2026. Figure: compare

The power ledger, Iran vs Israel: population, GDP (World Bank), military budgets (SIPRI 2025), forces (IISS), air power, missiles (estimates, 2025 and 2026 use, contested survival figures), nuclear (0 vs ~90), US aid, US forces and the 2026 war bill; what the ledger shows and does not. Figures: stats; money
